svg.aria-label: The diagnosis acute pyelonephritis as a mat: its attributes, and everything one relationship away as cards in labelled containers.
svg.text: Pyelonephritis in its acute phase: edema and tubular obstruction that produce the imaging manifestations below. A subtype rather than
an acuity element because acute and chronic disease manifest differently (subtype-over-attribute rule, 2026-08-25 exchange).
